About PulzeTrend Capital

Democratizing Professional Trading for Everyone

PulzeTrend Capital was founded in 2026 with a single conviction: that every trader deserves access to institutional-grade technology, fair pricing, and transparent conditions.

We launched as a boutique brokerage and are already serving 100+ clients worldwide — built on personal service, integrity, and a commitment to fair trading conditions.

Our Journey

Milestones That Define Us

  1. Jan 2026

    Company Founded

    PulzeTrend Capital incorporated with a mission to make institutional-grade Forex trading accessible to all.

  2. Mar 2026

    Platform Development

    Began development of nTrader, our proprietary trading platform built for speed, reliability, and simplicity.

  3. May 2026

    Beta Launch

    Soft-launched to an early community of 50+ traders for platform testing and feedback.

  4. Jul 2026

    Official Launch

    Officially opened to the public with Standard, ECN, and Pro account types and full USDT funding support.

  5. 2026+

    Growth Ahead

    Expanding our client base, adding new trading instruments, and scaling support across global markets.

Our Commitment

Built on Three Core Promises

Client Funds First

All client funds are held in fully segregated accounts — completely separate from company operations. Your capital is always protected.

Always by Your Side

Our support team is available 24/5 via live chat and email — real people ready to help you at every step of your trading journey.
